title: Sprint 2: Mobile Experience, PWA Offline & Audio Effects
goal: Enhance mobile web touch interactions, add Progressive Web App offline caching and installation support, and add immersive ocean soundscapes to the chest reveal.

issues.title: [PWA & Mobile] Offline Caching & Add to Home Screen Support
issues.user_story: As a mobile user, I want to install HeyFutureJasmine! as a PWA on my iPhone/Android home screen and have cached assets load instantly even on slow connections.
acceptance_criteria: Web app manifest provides icons, theme colors (#150c22), and standalone display mode.
Service worker caches static CSS, fonts, and map textures for offline resilience.
Offline fallback page informs user when offline without white-screen crash.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [PWA Test] Audit site with Chrome DevTools Lighthouse -> verify PWA criteria pass.
2. [Offline Test] Toggle browser offline mode -> navigate between pages -> verify cached shell and offline indicator render cleanly.

issues.title: [Media & Audio] Atmospheric Ocean Sounds & Reveal Audio
issues.user_story: As a user opening a delivered treasure chest, I want optional atmospheric sounds (gentle ocean tide, creaking chest lid opening) so the reveal feels truly magical.
acceptance_criteria: Subtle sound effects play when 3D chest opens during reveal ceremony.
Sound respects user preference (muted by default with persistent volume/unmute toggle in navbar).
No audio errors or blocking on mobile Safari.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [UI Audio Test] Open delivered chest on desktop and mobile -> verify sound plays smoothly when unmuted.
2. [State Test] Mute sound -> verify preference is preserved in localStorage.
